intro: Gingermite has been featured across leading publications for our unique mother-and-son approach to floral design and our installations for brands including Dior, Gucci, Tiffany's, and Apple.

articles.title: 最值得追蹤的3個本地時尚花藝師

articles.title: A Family Affair: Gingermite
articles.description: An in-depth feature on the mother-and-son duo behind Gingermite — from Ginger's 25-year hiatus to raise her family, to their creative process inspired by oil paintings.

articles.title: Make Your Pride Bloom on iPhone with Gingermite
articles.description: Official Apple workshop where participants explored the language of flowers with Gingermite, then created digital wallpapers using iPad and Apple Pencil.

articles.title: Mother's Day 2020: Luxe Gifts That Say 'I Love You'

articles.title: 7 Queer-Owned Businesses in APAC to Support
articles.description: Gingermite highlighted for their personalised approach — sketching arrangements before creating them, with attention to lighting, composition, and aesthetic.
